description: A stereo auto-panner and tremolo driven by one LFO whose shape you can morph between four waveforms

params.text: Chooses what the LFO does: pan moves the signal between the two channels, tremolo moves its level
Sets how deep the effect goes, none at the far left and full at the far right
Sets the LFO rate, 0.01Hz at the far left and 20Hz at the far right, and is ignored while a clock is patched
Bends the LFO's output curve, straight at the far left and increasingly curved at the far right
Morphs the LFO between four shapes in turn: sine, triangle, a rising saw and sample and hold, with anything between them a blend of the two nearest
Sets how far apart the two channels are in the LFO cycle, and holding it down turns the LFO polarity inside out

inputs.text: The right channel in, which takes a copy of the left when it has no cable
Shifts the phase offset between the channels, a full turn across the range
Locks the LFO to the pulses arriving here, whatever the time mode is set to

notes: the phase control is an endless encoder rather than a knob with end stops, and a long press on it inverts the LFO
menu: AutoPanTremolo — a heading over the items under it
Freq Curve — sets how sharply the freq knob's travel maps onto rate, offered as a list of exponents and as Softer and Steeper steps
Softer (-0.10) — inside Freq Curve; makes the freq knob's travel more even
Steeper (+0.10) — inside Freq Curve; crowds more of the freq knob's range into its upper end
SSD1306 128x64 preview — draws the small screen preview used when the patch is carried over to a Daisy board
SSD1306 Tint — sets the colour the preview is drawn in
Wave Bottom Bar — draws a strip under the waveform display
